articles.title: PM Modi inaugurates Northeast’s first Emergency Landing Facility in Moran. Why it matters?
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Northeast's first Emergency Landing Facility (ELF) at Moran, Dibrugarh, Assam. This strategic infrastructure project significantly enhances regional air connectivity and preparedness for emergencies. Such facilities are crucial for bolstering national security, disaster response, and improving overall operational readiness in remote areas, marking a significant step in regional development.

articles.title: PM Narendra Modi makes historic landing at Northeast's first emergency landing facility in Assam's Dibrugarh
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi made a historic landing at the Northeast's first Emergency Landing Facility in Assam's Dibrugarh. This 4.2-km reinforced stretch on National Highway-3 marks a critical infrastructure development. Such facilities enhance regional connectivity, improve disaster response, and offer strategic advantages for national security, aiding rapid deployment during emergencies and bolstering India's preparedness.

articles.title: 72 countries, 60 warships, including of US & Russia, to participate in international fleet review, MILAN exercise
articles.summary: India is set to host the MILAN exercise, a significant international fleet review. This major naval event will gather 72 countries and 60 warships, including vessels from global powers like the US and Russia. For SSB aspirants, this highlights India's growing strategic importance in global maritime security and its commitment to fostering international defence cooperation.
